statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval
